tasks.gr7-sun-earth-relationship-and-gravity-t: Topic: Sun-Earth relationship and gravity. Cover seasons, Moon phases, tides, gravity, and relative positions of Earth, Moon, and Sun. Ask Grade 7 learners to interpret orbit diagrams, explain phase sequences, and connect gravity to observed patterns.
tasks.gr7-electrical-systems-and-control-t4: Topic: Electrical systems and control. Cover series and parallel circuits, switches, inputs, processes, outputs, and electrical safety. Ask Grade 7 learners to read circuit scenarios, identify faults, choose safe actions, and evaluate simple control solutions.
